name: @sjawhar/dispatch
//: test: each bun test command's --timeout is at least twice the slowest row or hook it ran under 8 busy loops on 2 CPUs at 61b66deb (two builds Jobs) or on CI.

test:web, 30000 (15000 before #4437's round 4), read again at INFRA-3149's head 84270ff1 (two runs in builds Job gf-bun-dispatch-web-2, under the same load): every document of the table reads in a DOM as the table says it reads, 5,003.03 ms (4,594.21 ms in the second run; the slowest hook, stored-text-drawing.test.tsx's beforeAll, 500 ms), which this branch's first guard, 10000, held only 1.9988 times; main's 60000 had no reading beside it. Read again at 73e417f1 with #4437's fifth merge, in main's random order (two runs each in builds Jobs d8-m5-web-8 and d8-m5-cold-8, under the same load): 6,097.85 ms in test:web (AskCard sends an answer pressed while the ask is read again after a question back), and 7,091.20 ms in test:web:cold, which runs test:web with its lazy loads held (every shared control keeps an accessible name). Read again at #4437's round-4 tree 24b2e96b28, with web/src/features/margin/Margin.arriving.test.tsx in it, as `test:web web/src` in random order under the same load (three runs in builds Job g4b-dash-web, legion-load-run-tp2jt, 2026-11-21, each hook timed by a preload the Job's patch added, since Bun prints no hook times): the slowest row but useIssueDrafts' exploration rows, shared-controls.tooltips.test.tsx's inside NoTooltips no shared control sets a title, 11,813.25 ms (8,489.88 and 8,489.91 ms the slowest of the other runs, fixture-table-readings.test.ts's no mark element stands between an inline leaf and its paragraph), whose twice, 23,626.50 ms, 15000 did not hold, so the guard was 25000; read again at 636666f853, with the class search's four stored-reading.test.ts rows (three runs in builds Job g4c-dash-web, legion-load-run-w6nmx, under the same load), the slowest row was fixture-table-readings.test.ts's every document of the table reads in a DOM as the table says it reads, 13,594.08 ms, whose twice, 27,188.16 ms, 25000 did not hold, so the guard is 30000, which holds it 2.21 times (the four new rows took at most 4,498.51 ms, MARKUP is linear in the text); the slowest hook, markdown-references.test.tsx's beforeAll, 782.06 ms; Margin.arriving.test.tsx's slowest row 1,576.45 ms; useIssueDrafts.test.ts's other rows, which stay in test:web, at most 114.71 ms (a draft with a title queued behind another field's write keeps the reader's text as another reader's titles arrive). test:web leaves out useIssueDrafts.exploration.test.ts, which runs in test:web:drafts, the next line.

test:web:drafts, 1000000, runs web/src/features/issue/useIssueDrafts.exploration.test.ts alone, with test:web's preloads: the eight exploration rows of main's #4226, which share one exploration, about 171,000 sequences of five events, which the first of them to run pays for. Read inside `test:web web/src` under the same load, before the rows left useIssueDrafts.test.ts for that file (the same three runs of builds Job g4b-dash-web, legion-load-run-tp2jt, 2026-11-21): that first row took 459,996.70, 382,813.81 and 482,478.56 ms, whose twice, 964,957.12 ms, 1000000 holds (2.07 times). The rows' own limit, 1,100,000 ms, went when this command came.

test:harness, which runs e2e/__tests__, 60000: the pull-request lane stays inside its budget, and inside its real-stack share, 29,450.42 ms over 20 green merge-group runs on CI (9,898.28 ms under the loops, where the slowest row was no row runs twice in one configuration, 13,500.67 ms). It preloads the row-deadline preload alone, none of test:web's DOM preloads, and runs as the node processes those harness tests are; each part of `test` passes its own --timeout, the numbers these lines give.

scripts.test: bun run build:contracts && bun run test:web web/src && bun run test:web:drafts && bun run test:harness e2e/__tests__
scripts.e2e: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:clock: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium-alone --project=firefox-alone --project=webkit-alone --workers=1
scripts.e2e:embedder: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_EMBEDDER=fake playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium search-tiers
scripts.e2e:multiprocess: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_BUILD=e2e-b vite build --config web/vite.config.ts --outDir dist-b && DISPATCH_E2E_PROCESSES=2 DISPATCH_E2E_EMBEDDER=1 DISPATCH_E2E_WEB_DIST_B=${DISPATCH_E2E_WEB_DIST_B:-../dispatch/web/dist-b} playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:deployed: bun run build:contracts && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e:stub: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
scripts.e2e:stub:record: bun run build:contracts && bun run build:web && DISPATCH_E2E_STUB_RECORD=1 playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=stub --project=stub-phone
